description: Scaffold the complete backend infrastructure using only Node.js built-in modules. This includes: custom HTTP server with static file serving, custom router, .env loader, multipart form parser, rate limiter, file parsing (txt/pdf/docx), Claude API client with JSON validation/retry, and the /api/roast + /api/health endpoints. Also create package.json, .env.example, and basic project structure.
steps: Create package.json with name 'resume-roaster', type 'module', scripts for start (node server/index.js) and dev (node --watch server/index.js) and test (node --test server/tests/). No dependencies section needed since we use only built-ins.
Create server/lib/envLoader.js - reads .env file, parses KEY=VALUE lines (handles comments, empty lines, quotes), sets process.env values. Pure built-in fs usage.

Create server/lib/router.js - a minimal router class that registers GET/POST handlers by path, parses URL, extracts query params, dispatches to handlers. Handles 404. Supports middleware-style next().
Create server/lib/multipart.js - parses multipart/form-data request bodies. Extracts fields and files (with filename, content-type, and Buffer data). Uses only Buffer manipulation and string parsing.
Create server/lib/rateLimit.js - token bucket rate limiter keyed by IP address. Configurable max tokens and refill rate. Returns 429 JSON response when exceeded. Cleans up stale entries periodically.

Create server/lib/parseFile.js - exports parseFile(buffer, mimetype, filename). For .txt: decode as UTF-8. For .pdf: extract text content by finding text streams between BT/ET markers and decoding them (basic but functional). For .docx: use zlib.unzipSync to extract XML content from the zip, parse word/document.xml to extract text nodes by stripping XML tags.

Create server/lib/claudeClient.js - makes HTTPS POST to https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages. Constructs system prompt based on intensity (mild/medium/nuclear) and optional targetRole. Sends resume text as user message. Parses response, extracts JSON from Claude's response text. If JSON parsing fails, retries once with a 'return valid JSON only' instruction. Validates the response has required fields (overallScore, headline, sections, strengths, topFixes, atsFlags).

Create server/routes/roast.js - POST /api/roast handler. Accepts JSON body (text, intensity, targetRole) OR multipart form data (file upload + fields). Validates input (>50 words). Calls parseFile if file uploaded, then calls claudeClient. Returns JSON response. Handles errors gracefully.

Create server/index.js - entry point. Loads env vars, creates HTTP server, sets up router with: GET /api/health (returns {status:'ok'}), POST /api/roast (with rate limiting), and static file serving for everything under public/ directory (with proper MIME types for .html, .css, .js, .png, .svg, .ico). Listens on PORT from env.
Create server/tests/envLoader.test.js - tests the env loader with mock .env content
Create server/tests/rateLimit.test.js - tests token bucket logic (allow, deny after limit, refill)
Create server/tests/parseFile.test.js - tests txt parsing and basic structure validation for pdf/docx parsers
Create server/tests/router.test.js - tests route registration and dispatch
acceptance_criteria: Running 'unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check server/index.js' passes with no syntax errors
Running 'unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --test server/tests/' passes all tests
Starting the server with 'unset NODE_OPTIONS && node server/index.js' and hitting localhost:3000/api/health returns {status:'ok'}
The rate limiter correctly blocks after threshold is exceeded
The multipart parser correctly extracts file data from multipart form data
The env loader correctly reads .env files and sets process.env values
verification: unset NODE_OPTIONS && node --check server/index.js && node --check server/routes/roast.js && node --check server/lib/claudeClient.js && node --check server/lib/parseFile.js && node --check server/lib/rateLimit.js && node --check server/lib/router.js && node --check server/lib/multipart.js && node --check server/lib/envLoader.js
Start server in background, curl http://localhost:3000/api/health, verify JSON response, kill server
